Maya (Product): Heads-up — we need to trim the dependency list for SLA Slate launch next month. Running short on infra slots and security sign-off. Can teams confirm hard blockers today?
Tom (Eng): We're blocked on runtime change: adaptive batching needs opt-in flag for canary. ETA EOD for PR.
Anya (Runtime): I can toggle a compatibility shimming layer but it'll cost ~5-8% latency spike for short seqs. Option: canary with 10% traffic.
Maya (Product): do we have numbers? need tradeoffs for PM/exec.
Anya (Runtime): rough numbers: baseline p50 60ms -> 65ms (+8%). p95 220 -> 240. Cost +3% token CPU.
Jit (Infra): infra slots: we can allocate 2 reserved pools for canary but need infra window Thu 01:00-04:00 UTC for prewarm. Also need HSM/KMS rotation plan for Private customers.
Lena (Security): For HSM rotation, need audit plan + test keys. Can't approve until penetration test on key rotation flow is scheduled. Timeline: 4 business days.
Priya (SRE): We'll own rollback runbook. Need health checks: error_rate < 0.5% and latency p95 < 300ms. If breach, auto-roll to fallback model.
deploy-bot: Canary started: job_id=canary-3081234, targets=10% traffic.
Tom (Eng): Thanks — can we gate rollout on feature flag `adaptive_batching_v2`? also need to pin model versions.
Maya (Product): yes pin model + fallback. Product asks for canary metric dashboard: latency, error_rate, cost delta, quality regression on prompt set.
Anya (Runtime): I'll add tracing hooks and a lightweight eval run against gold prompts every 15min.
Lena (Security): For Private customers using Dedicated, we need an opt-out option and documented data flow. Send doc link.
Tom (Eng): prepping PR and runbook: https://internals/redwood/ops/sla-slate-runbook
Maya (Product): Action items: Tom -> PR + runbook (EOD). Anya -> tracing + eval (tomorrow morning). Jit -> schedule prewarm window (today). Lena -> schedule rotation pen test (start Mon). Priya -> finalize rollback rules (today).
Maya (Product): If anyone can't meet these, call it out now — we may need to trim scope (no inline quantize, no private HSM at launch).
Jit (Infra): If we trim HSM at launch, we need comms to legal/enterprise sales. that will shift some customers to delayed private rollouts.
Maya (Product): Understood. Let's sync 16:00 UTC for a final gating check. :calendar:
Tom (Eng): ack. I'll post PR link once ready.
Priya (SRE): I'll prepare the alert thresholds and link to runbook.
Lena (Security): scheduling pen test. will post date.
Maya (Product): Thanks team. Short and decisive.
